import React from 'react';
import { Card, CardContent, Typography, Box, Stack, LinearProgress, Chip } from '@mui/material';
import AutoAwesomeRoundedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/AutoAwesomeRounded';

function AiInsightsCard() {
  return (
    <Card>
      <CardContent>
        <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} alignItems="center" mb={2}>
          <Box sx={{ color: '#2563EB', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center' }}>
            <AutoAwesomeRoundedIcon />
          </Box>
          <Typography variant="h6">AI Insights</Typography>
        </Stack>
        <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" mb={2}>
          The platform detected a dependency bottleneck in payment retries and recommends mitigation before the next release window.
        </Typography>
        <Stack spacing={1.5}>
          <Box>
            <Typography variant="subtitle2" fontWeight={600}>Root Cause Summary</Typography>
            <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">Timeout jitter and retry storms are producing intermittent checkout failures.</Typography>
          </Box>
          <Box>
            <Typography variant="subtitle2" fontWeight={600}>Top Recommendation</Typography>
            <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">Introduce exponential backoff and circuit breaker safeguards.</Typography>
          </Box>
          <Box>
            <Stack direction="row" justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center" mb={0.8}>
              <Typography variant="subtitle2" fontWeight={600}>Release Readiness Score</Typography>
              <Chip label="82/100" color="success" size="small" />
            </Stack>
            <LinearProgress variant="determinate" value={82} sx={{ height: 8, borderRadius: 999, bgcolor: '#E5E7EB', '& .MuiLinearProgress-bar': { bgcolor: '#22C55E' } }} />
          </Box>
          <Box>
            <Typography variant="subtitle2" fontWeight={600}>Quality Assessment</Typography>
            <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">Stable overall, with focused attention needed on payments and auth paths.</Typography>
          </Box>
        </Stack>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

export default AiInsightsCard;
